title: Gold-set canary and calibration
description:
# Gold-set canary and calibration

## Intent

As a publication operator, I want a versioned canary of drafts with human (or agreed fixture) judgments, so we can see when a judge prompt or model change disagrees with the voice we care about.

## Done when

- A small fixture canary exists (excellent house voice, fluff, over-polished AI, factual-drift pair, short draft).
- Runner records scan/compare outputs keyed by promptVersion + model.
- Changing judge prompt or default model without updating the canary is visible in eval (fail or report drift).
- Complements `LIM-66c047` (eval harness); does not replace it.

## Out of scope

500-item production gold set in this stage. Fine-tuning on preference pairs.
